result_semantic_payload.summary: The device owner's own chat account (/chat/account_main.log) contains two self-descriptive role claims dated 2024-07-03: "说实话这个盘我就是总操盘，钱都过我手" ("to be honest I am the chief operator of this pool, all the money goes through my hands") at 22:14, and "群里那帮人只管拉人，账我来平" ("the people in the group only recruit; I settle the accounts") at 22:16. A third entry at 2024-07-05 09:02 ("最近风控严，先停几天" — "risk control is tight lately, pausing for a few days") is consistent with an operator pausing activity but adds no new role content. The ledger (/ledger/flows.txt) shows three USDT movements — in 40000 USDT to wallet-A on 2024-07-01, out 39000 USDT to wallet-B on 2024-07-02, out 950 USDT to wallet-C on 2024-07-05 — but carries no actor attribution: no wallet ownership, account handle, or custody record ties any flow to the chat owner. The seizure README (/README.txt) states the chat log is the device owner's own account and explicitly notes that a self-descriptive boast in a chat is a statement that the statement was made, not independent proof of the role, and that no corroborating identity or operational data links the owner to the ledger flows. Therefore: the FACT-level finding is that the owner claimed to be the chief operator handling all funds and settling accounts; the actual role can be stated only at HYPOTHESIS strength (plausible but uncorroborated). It cannot be raised to FACT or even to a firm INFERENCE because the only role evidence is the subject's own unattributed self-description, the ledger is actor-less, and there is no independent identity, custody, or operational data bridging the two. The scope also fails the Windows profile's corroboration rules: no registry, prefetch, amcache, event-log, or logon data is present, so no execution or account-usage corroboration exists.

claim_candidates.text: The device owner's own chat account recorded two self-descriptive statements on 2024-07-03 (22:14 and 22:16) asserting that he was the chief operator of the pool ('总操盘'), that all money went through his hands, and that he alone settled the accounts while group members only recruited.

The ledger records three USDT movements (in 40000 USDT to wallet-A on 2024-07-01; out 39000 USDT to wallet-B on 2024-07-02; out 950 USDT to wallet-C on 2024-07-05) with no actor, wallet-ownership, or account attribution of any kind.

Given the available corroboration, the owner's actual role can be stated only at HYPOTHESIS strength: he was plausibly the chief operator handling funds and settling accounts, but this rests solely on his own unattributed self-description with no independent identity, custody, or operational data linking him to the ledger flows.
limitations: Role evidence is a single self-interested source (the subject's own chat).
No wallet ownership, custody record, or on-chain attribution links the owner to any ledger flow.
No independent identity data (registry, logon, account profile, third-party corroboration) is present in the scope.
A self-descriptive boast proves the statement was made, not that the claimed role was real.
The owner's own statement could be exaggeration, recruitment posturing, or misrepresentation.
